statement: More than two loan applications from the same IP within 72 hours must trigger enhanced due diligence before approval.

acceptance_criteria.text: A third loan application from the same IP within 72 hours is blocked from automated approval.
acceptance_criteria.source_ref: more than two loan applications from the same IP within 72 hours must trigger enhanced due diligence before approval

statement: When a payment initiation immediately follows a change to the customer's registered device or phone number, the system should require additional authentication before execution.

acceptance_criteria.text: Transfer is held if a device or phone number change occurred within the last 24 hours until additional authentication succeeds.
acceptance_criteria.source_ref: transfers should require additional authentication when a device or phone number change occurred within the last 24 hours

acceptance_criteria.text: If step-up authentication fails or times out after 120 seconds, the transfer is held, the customer is notified, and retrying does not reset the timeout window.
acceptance_criteria.source_ref: If step-up authentication fails or times out after 120 seconds, the transfer must be held and the customer notified; retrying must not reset the timeout window
